description.value: Blowfish Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood, hand-crafting sushi and Japanese dishes since 2010. The head chef trained under a renowned Japanese master chef, and the menu spans sashimi, sushi rolls, and hot dishes made with premium-grade fish and seasonal produce. It describes itself as a 'hidden jewel' with a welcoming atmosphere in an urban neighbourhood setting.
